::: page-header
# Resources
:::

<div class="dev-banner">In development</div>

These public resources may help parents, schools, and children understand school attendance problems, emotional distress, and available support. This is a starting point for information, not a substitute for individual clinical or emergency advice.

In an emergency, call 000. Lifeline: 13 11 14 (24/7). Kids Helpline: 1800 55 1800 (ages 5–25, 24/7).

## For parents and carers

- [ReachOut Parents](https://parents.au.reachout.com/) — practical information for supporting young people.
- [Kids Helpline](https://kidshelpline.com.au/parents) — information and support for parents and carers.
- [Parentline Victoria](https://www.parentline.com.au/) — support for parents and carers in Victoria.

## For children and young people

- [Kids Helpline](https://kidshelpline.com.au/) — free counselling and support for children and young people.
- [ReachOut](https://au.reachout.com/) — mental health information and peer support.
- [headspace](https://headspace.org.au/) — youth mental health services and information.

## For schools and professionals

- [Australian Education Research Organisation: school attendance](https://www.edresearch.edu.au/research/projects/school-attendance) — evidence and resources on attendance.
- [Victorian attendance policy](https://www2.education.vic.gov.au/pal/attendance/policy) — state guidance on attendance responsibilities and responses.
- [2023 Senate inquiry into school refusal](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Education_and_Employment/SchoolRefusal) — Australian policy context.

## Research and policy context

These selected papers from the [reading list](reading-list.qmd) are useful starting points for understanding distinctions, definitions, and intervention evidence. Each summary is deliberately brief; follow the title for the journal version or use **Copy APA 7** for a formatted reference.

<script>
function copyResourceApa(button, citation) {
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(citation).then(function() {
    var original = button.textContent;
    button.textContent = 'Copied';
    setTimeout(function() { button.textContent = original; }, 1400);
  });
}
</script>
